sources.title: Imposto sobre Valor Acrescentado (IVA) — explanatory page
sources.institution: Alfândegas da Guiné-Bissau (Direção-Geral das Alfândegas, Ministério da Economia e Finanças)
sources.coverage: IVA import rates (19% standard, 10% Annex I, 0% export — Art. 18º); taxable base (Art. 17º); non-declarant surcharge (Art. 6º); deduction rules (Art. 19º); payment on customs clearance (Art. 26º)
sources.notes: Official page of the Guinea-Bissau customs authority (Alfândegas, under the Ministério da Economia e Finanças), directly quoting article numbers of the Código do IVA (Lei nº 4/22 de 25 de fevereiro). Downloaded 2026-07-26. This is the customs authority's own explanatory page, not the raw statute PDF itself — no full consolidated Código do IVA text was located/archived in this cycle. Corrects a prior placeholder that fabricated an 18% rate and a nonexistent "impots.gnb" domain (Guinea-Bissau's real ccTLD is .gw, not .gnb) — the verified rate is 19% standard / 10% (Annex I) / 0% (exports), not the UEMOA-uniform 18% assumed by the prior placeholder.

sources.title: IVA commencement announcement (1 January 2025)
sources.institution: Ministério da Economia e Finanças (Direção-Geral das Contribuições e Impostos)
sources.coverage: commencement date of the IVA regime (1 January 2025), replacing the former Imposto Geral sobre Vendas (IGV)
sources.notes: The Código do IVA was approved by Lei nº 4/22 (25 February 2022) but only entered into force on 1 January 2025, per multiple independent press reports citing an announcement by the Director-General of Contributions and Taxes (24noticias.sapo.pt, e-global.pt, forbesafricalusofona.com, ang.gw, all dated around December 2024/January 2025). The Ministry of Finance's own announcement page (mef.gw) could not be fetched directly in this environment (connection reset — same class of failure as other .gw government domains); the 2025-01-01 commencement date used in vat_measures.json is corroborated by these independent secondary reports, not by direct archival of the primary announcement itself.
